messages:
Lena: Quick heads-up  Helios POC wants a performance validation tomorrow 09:45 PT. They want a realistic mixed workload: 900 sustained qps, 40m soak. Mix: 35% chat (avg ctx ~1500 tokens), 65% embeddings (batch embeds, target 1500 emb/sec). SLA: chat p95 < 220ms, p99 < 550ms. They require customer CMK envelope encryption and full unwrap audit. Need a short run plan, ops config, and a ballpark cost delta. Can @Marco take infra and @Ivy own the harness?

Marco: Recommend Dedicated in us-west-2 with pinned nodes. For 1500-token contexts and that qps, expect 5-7 GPU equivalents depending on quant and model size. Enable prefix + KV cache and aggressive embed batching at gateway. Will provision KMS-proxy in the POC VPC so unwrap latency is stable.

Ivy: I'll own the harness. Proposed phases: smoke (4m @75 qps), step-ramp (18m to 900 qps), soak (40m), cooldown (6m). Collect p50/p95/p99 per phase, embed throughput, embed batch distribution, kv hit rate, and span traces. I'll push results to the POC dashboard and attach small flamegraphs. Load config I'll run:
```json
{"target_qps":900,"phases":["smoke","ramp","soak","cooldown"],"ramp_minutes":18,"soak_minutes":40,"mix":[{"type":"chat","pct":35,"ctx":1500},{"type":"embed","pct":65,"embed_batch_max":64}],"metrics":["p50","p95","p99","embed_tps","kv_hit_rate"]}
```

Sam: Ops tuning to include: model_batch_size=10 for large ctx, token_budget_ms=220, kv_cache_ttl=12h, prefix_cache_eviction=20k, embed_batching=true, embed_worker_threads=12. Fallback: if queue_latency > 250ms for >30s, shift new embed requests to quantized-embed-v2 and reduce chat max_gen_tokens to limit tail. Also set request timeout=35s.

Jill: Security note: CMK unwrap per embed-batch can add ~6-18ms depending on HSM. With large embed batches you'll amortize unwrap cost, but ensure audit logs are enabled at 100% for unwrap events. We'll need the signed KMS addendum and the CMK ARN ahead of time. Marco: can you confirm whether customer-managed CMK is required for POC?

Marco: Yes, Helios insists on customer CMK. I'll DM legal for the addendum and provision the KMS-proxy. For the POC we will cache unwrapped key material for 45s TTL to avoid HSM spikes; document included in checklist.

Lena: Great. @Ivy schedule for 09:45 PT and tag run "helios-poc-5860011223". @Sam and @Marco please drop the ops config snippet and KMS checklist by EOD. @Jill please coordinate legal on the addendum.

bench-bot: Run scheduled by Ivy  id: br-5860011223, start_time: 2026-06-15T16:45:00Z, phases: smoke/ramp/soak/cooldown.

Ivy: Harness queued, smoke script validated. Will enable tracing headers and sample spans at 0.1. Will post concise results (p50/p95/p99 + one-line ops action list) after soak.

Sam: I'll assemble the ops JSON and post before EOD; will include fallback routing rules and runtime flags.

Jill: I'll send the KMS checklist to Helios today: 1) CMK ARN & ownership confirm, 2) signed KMS addendum, 3) allowlist endpoints, 4) KMS-proxy creds, 5) test unwrap report.

Lena: Thanks team. Keep this under NDA and mark any policy blockers. :thumbsup:
